comments: Encoder-depth experiment at the SoC input resolution (8 Doppler x 64 Range, see kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64.json). Rather than widening bottleneck_ch (kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64_wide128.json: clean negative, 0.3049 val dice vs baseline's 0.3070, statistically tied), this drops down2's stride from 2 to 1 (shallow_encoder=True in kurals/models/kuralsnet_npu_seg.py), keeping the bottleneck at /4 (2, 16) instead of /8 (1, 8) spatially -- upconv_b's matching upsample is also dropped to keep the decoder's skip-concat aligned. Targets the actual diagnosed bottleneck (near-zero spatial extent at /8 for this tiny input) rather than channel capacity, which the wide128 run already showed doesn't help. Same hyperparameters as kuralsnet_npu_seg_8x64.json otherwise, so encoder depth is the only changed variable.
